questions.statement: What time is it? Choose the correct question to ask for the time.
questions.context: Clase de ingles de sexto grado en la que se repasa la manera de preguntar y decir la hora.

options.feedback: That question asks for an age, not for the time, so it cannot be used to ask the time.
What time is it is the standard way to ask the time in English.
That question asks for a price and has a different structure from the one about the time.
That question asks for a place and has nothing to do with the clock.

questions.explanation: What time is it se usa con el reloj analogico o digital y se responde con una estructura como It is seven o It is half past seven. Como la hora tiene un uso propio, conviene memorizarla como bloque y no construirla por partes.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: The minute hand points to 12 and the hour hand points to 3. What time is it?
questions.context: Ejercicio de lectura de un reloj en una actividad sobre la rutina diaria.

options.feedback: When the minute hand points to 12, the exact hour is the one the hour hand shows, and that one points to 3.
Twelve o'clock would be the position the hour hand would be in, not the minute hand.
Half past three is three thirty, and at that moment the minute hand would be on the 6.
A quarter past three is three fifteen, and the minute hand would point to 3, not to 12.

questions.explanation: En las horas en punto la aguja de minutos esta siempre en el 12 y la aguja de horas indica el numero. Reconocer esa configuracion es lo que permite distinguir las tres en punto de las tres y media o las tres y cuarto.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.context: Ejercicio de conversion de la hora militar a la hora de reloj.

options.feedback: 13:00 corresponds to one o'clock and not to fifteen in the 24-hour format.
On a 12-hour clock the number cannot reach fifteen, because the cycle runs from one to twelve.
15:00 in the 24-hour format equals three in the afternoon on a 12-hour clock.
Three in the early morning is 3:00 a.m., not 15:00.

questions.explanation: Para pasar de 24 a 12 horas se toma el numero, se le restan doce cuando supera el doce y se conserva el sufijo. La confusion entre a.m. y p.m. es el error mas frecuente y se resuelve recordando que a.m. va de medianoche a mediodia.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Read: "The school bell rings at half past seven." At what time does it ring?
questions.context: Lectura de un horario de actividades escolares.

options.feedback: 7:00 would be the exact hour, but the text says half past seven.
Half past seven means seven thirty, which is written 7:30.
7:15 is quarter past seven, or seven fifteen, not half past seven.
8:30 would be half past eight, and the text is talking about seven thirty.

questions.explanation: Half past seven y quarter to eight describen el mismo instante con dos estructuras distintas: siete y media y ocho menos cuarto. Saber que ambas expresiones coinciden ayuda a entender la hora tanto si se oye half past como si se oye quarter to.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: How do you say 09:45 in English?
questions.context: Ejercicio de escritura de la hora en un cuaderno de actividades.

options.feedback: A quarter to ten is nine forty-five, which is exactly what the exercise asks for.
A quarter past nine is nine fifteen, and not nine forty-five.
Half past nine is nine thirty, and the clock shows forty-five minutes.
Ten o'clock would leave the forty-five minutes unexplained, so it does not reach the time asked for.

questions.explanation: Los minutos entre el 45 y el 60 se expresan con quarter to o to, que cuentan hacia la hora siguiente. En este caso los 45 minutos equivalen a un cuarto para las diez, y por eso la respuesta correcta es a quarter to ten.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Read: "We leave home at seven and arrive at school at half past seven." How long is the trip?
questions.context: Actividad de conversacion sobre la hora de llegada a la escuela.

options.feedback: One hour would be the trip if the arrival were at eight o'clock.
Half an hour goes from seven to seven thirty, which is exactly the difference in the text.
That expression equals eight thirty, an hour that does not appear in the text.
Two hours would double the difference that the question states.

questions.explanation: Calcular una duracion a partir de dos horas es un ejercicio de comprension numerica disfrazado de ejercicio de reloj. La estrategia es restar la hora de llegada a la hora de partida y expresar el resultado con una de las estructuras de minutos.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Choose the correct sentence to propose a time.
questions.context: Ejercicio de negociacion de la hora de una reunion entre companeros.

options.text: Is at four o'clock possible for you?
options.feedback: The sentence is missing the subject and the auxiliary of the interrogative present simple.

options.text: Is four o'clock possible for you?
options.feedback: The structure Is four o'clock possible is built as a question with the verb to be at the front.

options.text: Four o'clock is possible for you?
options.feedback: Placing the question word at the end without a verb produces a sentence that is not a correct question.

options.text: Are four o'clock possible for you?
options.feedback: The plural verb to be does not agree with the singular subject four o'clock.

questions.explanation: Las preguntas que empiezan por el verbo to be colocan el verbo delante del sujeto. Esa inversion, junto con la concordancia entre are e is, es lo que se revisa en la unidad de preguntas del presente simple.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Read: "The dance starts at five and the football match finishes at a quarter to seven." What time does the football match finish?
questions.context: Lectura de un programa de actividades de una tarde de festival escolar.

options.feedback: 6:45 is quarter to seven, which is exactly what the text says.
7:15 is quarter past seven and would be a different result from the one in the sentence.
6:15 is quarter past six and does not correspond to a quarter to seven.
7:45 is quarter to eight and describes an hour later than the one in the text.

questions.explanation: Convertir quarter to seven en su forma numerica exige calcular un cuarto antes de las siete, es decir, 15 minutos menos de 60 en la hora. Ese calculo separa las cuatro expresiones que suele confundir a los estudiantes.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Which sentence uses the twelve-hour clock correctly?
questions.context: Ejercicio de descripcion del horario de la vida diaria de un estudiante.

options.feedback: A 12-hour clock does not reach nineteen, because its cycle runs from one to twelve.
19:00 in the 24-hour format is written 7:00 p.m. on a 12-hour clock.
Combining a number greater than twelve with the p.m. suffix repeats the information and is incorrect.

options.text: The library closes at 7:00 p.m. in the morning.
options.feedback: The p.m. suffix means in the afternoon and cannot be accompanied by the phrase in the morning.

questions.explanation: El sufijo p.m. reemplaza por completo la notacion de 24 horas y por eso jamas se combina con un numero mayor que doce ni con una frase que contradiga el momento del dia.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Which question asks about the time correctly?
questions.context: Actividad final de la unidad en la que se redacta la agenda personal de cada estudiante.

options.feedback: The At at the beginning is redundant in a question and leaves the sentence incomplete.
What time do you arrive asks for the hour of arrival with the standard present simple structure.
How is not used to ask the time, so that question is incorrect.
The question cannot end with the wh-phrase without an auxiliary verb.

questions.explanation: Las preguntas de tiempo en presente simple siguen el orden What time mas verbo mas sujeto, y no admiten How porque esa palabra interrogativa no existe para este uso. El orden de los elementos es lo que distingue una pregunta bien formada.
questions.subject: ingles
